title: Card Dispute Period Hold on a Giving School Nutrition Services Meal Account in a Sibling Netting
content:
On a School Nutrition Services Meal Account, online card deposits still inside the card dispute period stay on the giving account: when the account shows a returned deposit in the twelve months before the netting date and online card deposits in the two months before it, those online card deposits of the two months stay; when it shows no returned deposit in that period and online card deposits in the month before the netting date, those online card deposits of the month stay; otherwise none stay.

A date falls within the N months before the netting date when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the netting date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month or, when that later month has no such day, on the first day of the month after it.

## Combinations

| Returned deposit in the 12 months before the netting date | Online card deposits in the 2 months before it | Online card deposits in the 1 month before it | What stays |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | any | the online card deposits of the two months |
| yes | none | none | nothing |
| none | any | yes | the online card deposits of the month |
| none | any | none | nothing |

A returned deposit of any kind on the account counts toward the twelve-month test.

Hypothetical: a netting date of February 9, 2027 on an account with online card deposits of 25.00 on January 20 and 30.00 on December 18, 2026. With no returned deposit in the twelve months before that date, only the January deposit falls within the month before, so 25.00 stays. With a returned deposit in that twelve-month period, both fall within the two months before, so 55.00 stays.
